Everything above happened inside the period. The lines under this one describe the account as it stands the day this report was written: the app keeps events rather than snapshots, so what was open in a past month cannot be counted afterwards.

A goal is shown as it stands the day the report was written. This app records what changed about a goal, not which day it was reached, so a past period can state how much of its work counted toward a goal and cannot state whether the goal was reached during it.
A goal that names a set is finished or not, and nothing moves inside a period that a report can date.
A habit series is counted back from the last day of the period, so a run longer than the period is reported as at least its length.
